node.question: Did the source mug itself move toward or to the right of the headphones, and is the requested relation complete?
node.criteria: Compare the source-identified mug with its edited counterpart, not any other mug. Pass only when evidence identifies that same mug and shows it to the right of the headphones. Fail when the same mug is identifiable but is not to the right; explicitly report whether it moved toward the requested position (progress) or shows no movement toward it. Unknown when identity, movement, or relative position cannot be resolved. A different mug on the right does not establish completion or progress. For R1, complete only on a verified same-mug right-side relation; partial only on evidenced movement of that mug toward the right without completion; absent only with clear evidence of no requested progress; otherwise unknown.
node.binding: Use source and edited images and the source-mug identity/continuity evidence from s1. State which edited object is tracked and the visual basis for matching it. Compare its source and edited positions relative to the headphones; do not infer movement from the presence of other mugs.
